title: Tiny, cute crown
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="gold" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFD700"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FFA500"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="goldLight" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFE44D"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FFC107"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- Crown body -->
  <path d="M22 68 L18 36 L34 48 L50 26 L66 48 L82 36 L78 68 Z" fill="url(#gold)" stroke="#FFD700" stroke-width="1"/>
  <!-- Crown band -->
  <rect x="22" y="68" width="56" height="10" rx="3" fill="url(#goldLight)"/>
  <!-- Band detail -->
  <rect x="26" y="70" width="48" height="2" rx="1" fill="#FFF3B0" opacity="0.8"/>
  <!-- Jewel on center point -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="28" r="4" fill="#FF3B5C"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="27" r="2" fill="#FF8FA3"/>
  <!-- Left point jewel -->
  <circle cx="18" cy="38" r="3" fill="#3B9DFF"/>
  <circle cx="18" cy="37" r="1.5" fill="#8FCBFF"/>
  <!-- Right point jewel -->
  <circle cx="82" cy="38" r="3" fill="#3B9DFF"/>
  <circle cx="82" cy="37" r="1.5" fill="#8FCBFF"/>
  <!-- Tiny gems on band -->
  <circle cx="34" cy="73" r="2" fill="#44E68A"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="73" r="2" fill="#FF3B5C"/>
  <circle cx="66" cy="73" r="2" fill="#44E68A"/>
  <!-- Sparkle details -->
  <circle cx="52" cy="24" r="1" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.9"/>
  <circle cx="20" cy="34" r="0.8" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.8"/>
  <circle cx="80" cy="34" r="0.8" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.8"/>
</svg>
